notes.title: Pixel Fodder is TOTALLY FREE!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Pixel Fodder became absolutely free for Android too. 
Now you can download full version of the game on your smartphone, synchronise it with PC version and play Pixel Fodder with your characters and saves for free wherever you want.

notes.title: We're still alive!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Now we’re working on totally new version of Pixel Fodder. 

What we’ve already done:
- The main part of editor. There will be only one editor which means you'll create your own maps the same way we do.
- The maps' engine is redesigned.
- Light is added. The game’ll look cooler. 
- Rooms. Now levels will be more complicated.

What’s planned:
- New objects’ physics.
- New characters’ system (now you’ll have only 3 characters/lives for one level).
- Mobs/transport redesign.
- More guns and other loot. 
- More interactivity on the maps.

The full map editor will be ready for tests by New Year. Of course it won’t be the full game, but you’ll already have the opportunity to test the new features and draw your own maps.

Thank you for being with us and keeping patience.
Wacha

notes.title: #Big Boom 0.12.77
notes.content:
Hi!

My name is Sergey.
Im designer from Moscow, and i making Pixel Fodder now.

So, let me tell you about Pixel Fodder (PF).

PF it is usual 2D platformer inspired but other cool games, my imagination and my love to crash everything. PF it is my very first "big game". Before i made one small game called Sea Battle 1974 and some small mod for other games.

PF made on Adobe Air platform and available on Android platform, and will be available on IOS/Mac soon (i hope). I dont use any game engine, just Starling Framework to draw everything in game, and Nape physics for collision detection.

All game files (maps, heroes etc) it is just xml file and in future i'll tell you how to mode your game, add maps, heroes, weapon, fx.
So. Thats all what i whant to tell you right now.

Sorry me my English, and best wishes!
